paper.abstract_en: In this work we investigate the tidal properties of the Dymnikova regular black hole and their ef fects on massive particles in radial free-fall. Starting from Dymnikova static, spherically symmetric solution, we derive the equations governing timelike radial geodesics and construct an orthonormal tetrad adapted to a free-falling observer. We then obtain the radial and angular components of the tidal tensor and analyze their dependence on the black hole mass and the characteristic length scale of the de Sitter core. At large radial distances, tidal forces recover Schwarzschild behavior, whereas near the regular center, both components remain finite, reflecting the non-singular nature of the spacetime. We show that the radial and angular tidal forces vanish and change sign at characteris tic radii inside the event horizon, indicating transitions between stretching and compression regimes. A particle released from rest outside the event horizon reaches a turnaround point located inside the Cauchy horizon, rather than reaching the regular center. We also solve the geodesic deviation equations for two sets of initial conditions and examine the evolution of the radial and transverse components of the deviation vector. Although the solutions asymptotically reproduce Schwarzschild behavior, they differ significantly in the inner region: the deviation vector components remain finite up to the turnaround point, whereas the corresponding radial component in the Schwarzschild case diverges at the singularity. These results demonstrate how the de Sitter core regularizes the tidal dynamics of extended falling bodies.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对Dymnikova常现黑洞的潮汐力进行了详细分析，展示了去西特核心如何正则化内部动力学，属于广义相对论基础领域的前沿研究。
decision.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了Dymnikova常现黑洞的潮汐性质及其对径向自由落体中的大质量粒子的影响。从Dymnikova静态、球对称解出发，我们推导了控制类时径向测地线的方程，并构造了一个适用于自由落体观测者的标准正交标架。然后我们获得了潮汐张量的径向和角向分量，并分析了它们对黑洞质量和去西特核心特征长度尺度的依赖性。在大径向距离处，潮汐力恢复施瓦西行为，而在常现中心附近，两个分量保持有限，反映了时空的非奇异性。我们表明，径向和角向潮汐力在事件视界内的特征半径处消失并改变符号，指示拉伸和压缩状态之间的转变。从事件视界外静止释放的粒子到达位于柯西视界内的转折点，而不是到达常现中心。我们还求解了两组初始条件下的测地偏离方程，并检查了偏离矢量的径向和横向分量的演化。尽管解渐近地再现了施瓦西行为，但它们在内部区域显著不同：偏离矢量分量在转折点之前保持有限，而相应的径向分量在施瓦西情况下在奇点处发散。这些结果展示了去西特核心如何正则化扩展下落体的潮汐动力学。
